tools.name: open_github_repo
tools.description: Open a GitHub repository in Firefox. Call when user says 'open github repo anthropics/claude', 'show me the github for torvalds/linux', 'go to github user/repo'

tools.name: open_localhost
tools.description: Open localhost development server in browser. Call when user says 'open localhost 3000', 'show me localhost on port 5173', 'view localhost 8080'

port.description: Port number for the local development server (e.g., 3000, 5173, 8080)

tools.name: open_mdn_docs
tools.description: Search MDN Web Docs for a topic. Call when user says 'look up fetch API on MDN', 'MDN docs for flexbox', 'search MDN for async await'

query.description: Search query for MDN (e.g., 'fetch API', 'CSS grid', 'Promise')

tools.name: npm_install
tools.description: Install an npm package in current project. Call when user says 'npm install react', 'install lodash', 'add typescript as dev dependency'

tools.name: start_dev_server
tools.description: Start the development server (npm run dev). Call when user says 'start the dev server', 'run npm dev', 'start development'

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run test suite. Call when user says 'run tests', 'run the test suite', 'execute tests'

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Create a git commit with a message. Call when user says 'git commit with message fix bug', 'commit changes saying added feature', 'make a commit called updated docs'

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Push commits to remote repository. Call when user says 'push to github', 'git push', 'push changes to remote'

tools.name: open_vscode_project
tools.description: Open a project directory in VS Code. Call when user says 'open transcribe-rs in code', 'open vscode with myproject', 'code open ~/projects/website'

path.description: Path to project directory (can be absolute or relative, e.g., '~/code/myproject', '/path/to/projects/website')

tools.name: open_terminal_on_workspace
tools.description: Open a terminal on a specific workspace. Call when user says 'open terminal on workspace 5', 'launch kitty on workspace 3'

tools.name: screenshot_region
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a selected region. Call when user says 'take a screenshot', 'screenshot selection', 'capture region'

tools.name: docker_ps
tools.description: List running Docker containers. Call when user says 'list docker containers', 'show running containers', 'docker ps'

tools.name: docker_compose_up
tools.description: Start Docker Compose services. Call when user says 'start docker compose', 'docker compose up', 'bring up the containers'

tools.name: docker_compose_down
tools.description: Stop Docker Compose services. Call when user says 'stop docker compose', 'bring down containers', 'docker compose down'

tools.name: search_google
tools.description: Search Google for a query. Call when user says 'google search rust async', 'look up typescript generics', 'search for react hooks'

tools.name: focus_window_class
tools.description: Focus a window by its class name. Call when user says 'focus firefox', 'switch to chrome', 'show me code', 'go to terminal'

tools.name: system_update
tools.description: Update system packages with pacman. Call when user says 'update system', 'run pacman update', 'upgrade packages'

tools.name: kill_process_by_name
tools.description: Kill a process by name. Call when user says 'kill node', 'stop firefox', 'kill all chrome processes'

process_name.description: Process name or pattern to kill (e.g., 'node', 'firefox', 'npm')

tools.name: open_file_manager
tools.description: Open file manager at a specific path. Call when user says 'open downloads folder', 'show me projects directory', 'file manager in home'

tools.name: toggle_night_light
tools.description: Toggle Hyprland night light mode. Call when user says 'toggle night light', 'turn on blue light filter', 'enable redshift'
